name: io.github.xka0085-byte/receiptrail
title: ReceiptRail — x402 Delivery Receipts
description: On-chain x402 delivery receipts on Solana: hash-locked, verifiable proof of delivery.

tools.name: issue_receipt
tools.title: Issue delivery receipt
tools.description: After an x402 settlement on Solana, anchor a SHA-256 digest of the delivered content plus the settlement reference. Returns a permanent, publicly verifiable receipt so the buyer agent gets proof of delivery. Costs 0.001 USDC via x402; founding sellers free for 30 days.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.title: Verify delivery receipt
tools.description: Verify any x402 delivery receipt against live Solana state before accepting a paid delivery as final: PDA owner must match the ReceiptRail program, stored digest and payment reference must match. Anti-fraud check, read-only, no cost.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.title: Get receipt details
tools.description: Fetch full x402 delivery receipt details by receipt id or payment reference: digests, checks, outcome (settled/pending/failed), amount, buyer, seller, timestamp, PDA. Read-only, no cost.
